metadata.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal

problem_summary.summary: Reconstruct the unique tree represented by matching preorder and inorder traversals.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: preorder and inorder arrays of the same tree. Return its root.
constraints: Both arrays are valid traversals of the same tree

brute_force.explanation: Use the first preorder value as the root, linearly locate it in the current inorder interval, and recursively build the left and right intervals.
brute_force.correctness_idea: Preorder identifies the root first; its inorder position separates exactly the left and right subtrees, whose traversal segments are then reconstructed by the same rule.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n^2) worst case due to repeated linear searches in inorder.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(h) auxiliary recursion stack, excluding the returned tree.

optimized.explanation: Precompute each value's inorder index in a hash map. Recursive interval construction then finds every root split in expected constant time.
optimized.correctness_idea: The unique index of each root divides the inorder interval into its left and right subtrees; preorder segment lengths determine the matching recursive ranges.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) expected — each value is indexed once and each node is constructed once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(n) for the index map and output tree, plus O(h) recursion stack.

steps.event: Build from the full traversal intervals.
steps.condition: Inorder index 3 separates three left nodes from one right node.
steps.action: Create 8; recurse left on preorder [3,1,6] and inorder [1,3,6].

steps.condition: Inorder positions 0 and 2 contain the left and right descendants.
steps.action: Create node 3 with child roots 1 and 6.

steps.condition: Their inorder intervals are empty after selecting each root.
steps.action: Attach both as leaves and return the completed tree.

edge_cases.handling: Intervals create one child at each level; recursion depth is O(n).

edge_cases.case: Root has no left or right subtree
edge_cases.handling: An empty inorder interval returns null for that child.
